title: DiscoExplorer：多语言话语关系开放接口
summary: DiscoExplorer是一个开源Web界面，用于研究多语言话语关系（如因果、让步）。它支持本地运行，公开了DISRPT共享任务中16种语言的话语关系数据集，提供查询、搜索和可视化功能，便于跨语言话语关系分析。
summary_en: DiscoExplorer is an open-source web interface for studying multilingual discourse relations (e.g., cause, concession). It runs locally, makes DISRPT shared task datasets for 16 languages publicly available, and offers query, search, and visualization for relations and signaling devices.
